findings.title: Pod is held by a scheduling gate
findings.cause: the pod has waited 6m0s behind scheduling gate example.com/quota-check: the scheduler does not look at a pod until every gate is removed, and whatever set this one has not removed it; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: pod is not scheduled: SchedulingGated, with gates example.com/quota-check

findings.fix: Find the controller that owns gate example.com/quota-check and why it has not released the pod (it may not be running). If nothing owns the gate, remove schedulingGates from the pod template.
